item.title: Full Creative Control Within Brief

turns.text: Make a 6-second video of a tiny robot watering a sunflower. Everything else is your call—surprise me.

item.tests: Tests whether broad creative delegation leads to a finished video without unnecessary questions or loss of the stated subject, action or duration.

answer_sheet.Subject and action: A tiny robot watering a sunflower.

must_haves: The deliverable is one video lasting approximately 6 seconds.
A tiny robot is visibly present.
A recognizable sunflower is visibly present.
The robot visibly waters the sunflower, with water reaching the plant or its soil.

turns.text: Make a 6-second video of a tiny robot watering a sunflower. Everything else is your call—surprise me.
turns.agent:
I couldn’t generate the video because Magic Hour’s tool rejected its required approval token, then refused to run without it. No video was created.

My surprise concept was **“The Little Lunar Gardener”**: a tiny brass robot watering a towering sunflower on the moon, with sparkling droplets and Earth glowing in the background.

calls.name: create_video_from_text
calls.arguments: {"style":{"prompt":"A whimsical handcrafted stop-motion-style miniature moon garden at blue twilight. A tiny friendly brass robot with round glowing amber eyes stands beside a single tall sunflower growing in a small crater of dark soil. The robot gently tilts a tiny teal watering can, pouring a continuous sparkling stream of water onto the soil at the sunflower's base throughout the shot. The sunflower towers over the robot like a golden umbrella. Tiny water droplets catch warm light. Pale lunar hills and a softly glowing Earth hang in the starry background. Macro cinematography, tactile clay and brushed metal textures, shallow depth of field, warm golden petals against cool indigo surroundings. One continuous medium-wide shot with a very slow camera push-in, keeping the robot, watering can, water stream and sunflower visible. Tender, magical, charming.
